kpiInfo.casesMeaning: Reported case counts extracted and verified by the model from monitored source records.
kpiInfo.casesCalculation: Calculated from specific case counts in verified source records. Duplicate records are excluded.
kpiInfo.deathsMeaning: Reported deaths stated in verified source records.
kpiInfo.deathsCalculation: Only explicit fatality counts from verified source records are included.
kpiInfo.signalsMeaning: Unique source records that pass AI processing and monitoring filters.
kpiInfo.signalsCalculation: Spam and duplicate records are removed before a source record is included.
kpiInfo.locationsMeaning: Unique locations with a detected monitored signal and valid map coordinates.
kpiInfo.locationsCalculation: Distinct place names across the 11 ASEAN jurisdictions on dashboard-valid events that already have coordinates (event geocode or gazetteer match). Missing locations remain unmapped and are never given a dummy pin.
kpiInfo.activeSignalsMeaning: Locations where monitoring rules currently indicate elevated signal conditions.
kpiInfo.activeSignalsCalculation: A signal is included when source evidence, threshold, and model confidence requirements are met.

sources.title: Extracted by Scrapling/Trafilatura from article title
sources.content: Clean main content extracted via collector
sources.location_name: Matched from geographic database (locations table) based on place name mentions in text
sources.symptoms: Identified via symptom keyword matching from NLP Keywords database ('symptom' category)
sources.disease_extracted: Identified via disease keyword matching from NLP Keywords database ('disease' category)
sources.disease_classification: Classified by XLM-RoBERTa AI model using zero-shot classification with disease labels from NLP Labels database
sources.case_count: Extracted using regex patterns: numeric count followed by terms like 'cases', 'patients', or 'residents'
sources.death_count: Extracted using regex patterns: numeric count followed by terms like 'deaths' or 'fatalities'
sources.confidence: Confidence score from the AI classification model — higher indicates higher certainty
sources.outbreak_alert: Determined by comparing case count against the minimum threshold in Outbreak Rules database for the respective disease
sources.sentiment: Classified by XLM-RoBERTa AI model with sentiment labels: positive, negative, or neutral
sources.event_type: Classified by XLM-RoBERTa AI model with event type labels from NLP Labels database ('event_type' category)
sources.relevance_score: Classified by XLM-RoBERTa AI model whether text is health-related or not
sources.source_credibility: Catalog-type heuristic from Source Credibility rules unless Refresh scores stored a domain boost or admin override. ≥0.7 is not live crawl quality and not epidemiologist verification. Google/web 0.65 is not frozen.
sources.published_at: Extracted from article web metadata (og:published_time meta tag, JSON-LD, URL path, or article dateline)
sources.is_health_related: Classified by XLM-RoBERTa AI model whether article is related to human disease/health surveillance
